تستنسخوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْسِخُوا (tastansiḵū) /tas.tan.si.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
# تُسْتَنْسَخُوا (tustansaḵū) /tus.tan.sa.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
